interpretation.active: GR Active >10%; largely idle means GR Active <=2%.
interpretation.metrics: Device-wide metrics, including desktop graphics. Throughput percentages are peak-relative, not nvidia-smi memory utilization.
interpretation.cpu: CPU busy during GPU-idle windows is evidence of host-side work, not proof of a specific dependency or kernel stall.
interpretation.clocks: NVTX aligns Nsight with CLOCK_MONOTONIC only; raw OpenCL event clocks are not assumed synchronized.
interpretation.phases: Query reconstruction nests within the late phase; phase totals are not additive.
interpretation.per_kernel: OpenCL events are recorded on a separate, unaligned device clock, and event buffers report drops. Operation totals are usable; per-kernel roofline or stall-reason attribution is unavailable.
